verdict.rationale: The IP practice page explicitly lists trade secrets and confidential information as part of its advisory scope and references high-stakes IP litigation, and a Labour & Employment case study shows advising on a CTO's exit while protecting 'highly critical intellectual property and proprietary information' (an employee-mobility scenario). However, there's no dedicated content on designing confidentiality programs or a documented trade-secret litigation case study. Missing for 10: explicit confidentiality-program design service descriptions, named trade-secret litigation matters/case studies.
